whenToUse: Picking a place or part on a picture: rooms on a floor plan, parts of a product, buildings on a campus or venue map.
Explaining an image with labelled points and short details.
avoidWhen: Locations with latitude and longitude — use pin-map.
A plain list of options with no spatial meaning — use radio-group or toggle-group.
a11y: Every spot is a real button with an accessible name; single selection is a radio group, multiple selection uses aria-pressed toggle buttons.
One tab stop with arrow keys to the nearest spot in a direction, Home / End and Escape; provide a list or legend when the picture alone carries meaning.
